_meta.title: DFCC GCF candidate pipeline — illustrative
_meta.sampleNote: Illustrative dataset — not DFCC's pipeline. Figures marked benchmark or modelled require sourced values before submission.

accreditation.grantNote: The grant box is not ticked in DFCC's accreditation. A grant-dependent design is not deliverable by DFCC as the accredited entity — verify with DFCC or the NDA before this reaches a client conversation.
accreditation.source: DFCC DAE Readiness Pre-Qualified Delivery Partner ToR, version 21 November 2025, section 1.1

deliverable.note: The ToR asks for at least two high-potential concepts and up to two Concept Notes. Five is the screening pool; two is the output. The pipeline's job is to defend which two.

projects.name: Jaffna Peninsula Solar Mini-grids and Storage
projects.selectionReason: Squarely inside DFCC's demonstrated renewable-energy track record, cleanly on-lendable within its accreditation modalities, and maps directly to NDC 3.0's 33.9% power-sector reduction and the 70% renewables commitment.

yield_kwh_per_kwp.note: Sector default for the Northern dry zone. Replace with a site-measured or PVsyst yield.

financing.gcfInstrumentDetail: Concessional loan on-lent through DFCC. No grant element.

grantEquivalentPct.note: Grant-equivalent subsidy from tenor and coupon concession.

viabilityWithoutGcf.reason: Post-conflict Northern Province offtake risk and a thin local battery track record put unsupported debt pricing above the tariff's tolerance. GCF's tranche buys tenor, not margin.

baseline.description: Grid electricity displaced at the Sri Lankan national average emission factor
baseline.counterfactual: Without the project the same demand is met from the national grid

gridEF_tCO2e_per_mwh.note: MUST be replaced with the value the NDA and CEB publish, with its vintage. P1 and P5 both hinge on it.

direct.definition: Households connected or receiving materially improved supply

indirect.definition: Wider population in the served grid area

womenPct.note: District population share. Must be disaggregated at source from census/DS-division data.

projects.name: Dry Zone Irrigation and Tank Cascade Rehabilitation
projects.selectionReason: Strong adaptation case and the largest direct beneficiary count in the pool, but the restructuring away from grant leaves the concessionality argument thinner than P1 or P3.

financing.gcfInstrumentDetail: 30-year tenor with a long grace period. Restructured from a grant-heavy design because DFCC's accreditation does not cover the grant modality; the subsidy is delivered through terms rather than instrument type.

viabilityWithoutGcf.reason: Smallholder resilience has no revenue line to price against. The concessional core is the adaptation work; only the on-farm equipment tranche carries a return.

mitigation.coBenefitNote: Reported apart from the mitigation headline and never used to rank this project. Ranking a water project against a solar farm on carbon per dollar would systematically defund adaptation.

baseline.description: Diesel pumping displaced by rehabilitated gravity-fed cascades
baseline.counterfactual: Without the project farmers continue diesel-pumped abstraction

direct.definition: Farming households in the command areas

indirect.definition: Downstream water users and dependent rural economy

hectares.definition: Command area under improved climate-resilient management

valueProtected_usd.definition: Replacement value of irrigation infrastructure and standing crop better protected

projects.name: Colombo District Cooling and Commercial Retrofit
projects.selectionReason: The only candidate where the existing PCAF Part C engine already applies — a real A1-A5 bill of quantities — so the demonstration shows the whole stack working on one project, embodied carbon included. Also hits NDC 3.0's electricity-demand and low-GWP refrigerant commitments.

financing.gcfInstrumentDetail: Blended facility with a sustainability-linked margin ratchet tied to measured energy intensity.

viabilityWithoutGcf.reason: Split incentive between landlords and tenants leaves unsupported payback beyond commercial tenor. The concessional tranche closes the gap; the ratchet keeps performance honest.

annual_tCO2e.method: metered baseline consumption x efficiency saving x grid EF

baseline.description: Existing building energy consumption, metered over 12 months before intervention
baseline.counterfactual: Without the project the buildings continue at their current measured intensity

a1a5_tCO2e.method: BOQ x ICE v3 factors, via the Part C engine

embodiedCarbon.note: Inside the project boundary. Shown as a payback period and NEVER deducted from the bank's financed-emissions inventory — three different boundaries, three different questions.

direct.definition: Daily occupants of the retrofitted buildings

projects.name: Puttalam-Mannar Mangrove and Coastal Restoration
projects.selectionReason: Not selected, and the reason is a structuring conclusion rather than a judgement on the project. Ecosystem restoration has no revenue line and DFCC cannot intermediate grant, so even restructured to concessional debt plus results-based payment this likely needs a co-accredited entity for the grant element.
projects.essNote: Community and potentially indigenous land. Free, prior and informed consent required — a gate that triggers process, not a lower rank.

financing.gcfInstrumentDetail: Concessional loan 9.0M plus results-based payment 5.0M. Restructured from grant-heavy; see the modality gap above.

viabilityWithoutGcf.reason: No revenue line at all in the restoration core. Livelihood credit is the only bankable component.

annual_tCO2e.method: area x blue carbon sequestration rate

mitigation.coBenefitNote: Sequestration, not avoided emissions, and reported apart from the mitigation headline. Central rate needs a Sri Lanka-specific source before submission.

baseline.description: Degraded and cleared mangrove extent at project start
baseline.counterfactual: Without the project degradation continues at the observed trend
baseline.note: A removal is not a reduction. NDC 3.0 keeps them as separate commitments and so does this record.

direct.definition: Coastal households in the restoration footprint

indirect.definition: Wider coastal population benefiting from storm-surge attenuation and fishery recovery

hectares.definition: Coastal ecosystem restored or under improved management

valueProtected_usd.definition: Coastal property and infrastructure behind the restored buffer

projects.name: Western Province Electric Bus Fleet and Depot Charging
projects.selectionReason: Best cost per beneficiary in the pool and a direct NDC 3.0 transport-target match, but the residual-value risk needs a market assessment the readiness programme has not yet run. A strong candidate for the second round.

financing.gcfInstrumentDetail: First-loss and concessional tranche absorbing residual-value risk on a bus type with no Sri Lankan resale history.

viabilityWithoutGcf.reason: Fleet economics turn on a residual value no local lender will price. The risk-sharing facility is what makes the asset financeable at all.

annual_tCO2e.method: displaced diesel bus-km x fuel EF, net of charging grid emissions

baseline.description: Existing diesel bus fleet operating the same routes and service frequency
baseline.counterfactual: Without the project the diesel fleet is replaced like-for-like at end of life

gridEF_tCO2e_per_mwh.note: Charging emissions netted within the project boundary. Same national factor as P1 and needs the same replacement.

direct.definition: Daily passenger boardings on the converted routes

indirect.definition: Corridor population benefiting from reduced roadside PM2.5 and NOx

womenPct.note: Public transport ridership skews female in the Western Province.
